summary: Unlock the potential of Cloud Data Management through our specialized training. Acquire the skills needed to excel in this rapidly growing field.
lede: Cloud data management organizes and governs information across cloud and hybrid environments. For technical professionals and managers responsible for data lifecycles, the course addresses practical work such as selecting storage, designing automated ETL or ELT pipelines, and improving metadata, data quality, and access controls. It also covers data cataloging and cost and performance optimization to support reliable operations.
audienceIntro: This program is tailored for technical professionals and managers who are responsible for the lifecycle of data in cloud environments and must ensure its availability, integrity, and cost-effectiveness.
modules: Cloud Data Strategy and AI Integration
prerequisites: Participants should have a minimum of 2 years of experience in database administration, data engineering, or IT infrastructure management. A foundational understanding of cloud computing concepts (IaaS, PaaS, SaaS) and basic SQL proficiency is required. No prior programming or coding experience is necessary, though familiarity with cloud consoles (AWS, Azure, or GCP) is highly recommended.
